title: MMORPG Gurus I summon thee come help improve my game
author: Negative_Leave5161
selftext:
Been working on this for a few months: Isekai Slime World, [https://isekaislimeworld.com](https://isekaislimeworld.com)

Loki isekai'd you into another world, and your only way out is to climb 99 floors with your slimes.

Along the way you raise slimes and take them around fields. Either cozy idle with some music on, or go kill giant rabbits. You can also fish, train your slimes, and set up a little shop to sell stuff to other players. It runs in the browser with nothing to install.

It's in alpha and rough in places. I'd love to know:  
Did the first few minutes make sense?  
What felt off or ugly?  
Would you come back tomorrow?

my only problem right now is only 3% of the people are addicted, that number should be much much higher.

Bugs, complaints, and random ideas all welcome. Thanks for trying it 🙏

comments.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
comments.body: Ok, this may sound harsh, but the blur on the background makes me feel like I'm having a migraine attach and actually makes me feel physically sick. It's beautiful, but I can't just look at it for longer than 3 seconds. I had this issue with other games in the past and I know other people who have similar issues.

replies.author: Negative_Leave5161
replies.body: I got you fam. There is an option to turn in off it the settings.
